assessment: ELF file size is not RSS or cgroup charge; faults, constructors, allocator, TLS, page tables and supervisor stage can exceed harmless peak. 64MiB sufficiency cannot be established without Core execution. TasksMax counts loader threads and bwrap processes; 25% CPU can extend initialization beyond deadline.
proposed_alternative: Only if later authorized: separate 128MiB candidate, retaining TasksMax8/CPU25%; this is a review candidate, not a measured requirement. No limit changed.
